mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 70 degrees and fair near Badger Ridge Middle School.

The City of Verona has released candidate packets for the 2027 Spring Election, where seats in all four Aldermanic districts will be on the ballot, with paperwork due by January 5th to the City Clerk.

Today is packed with fun including Live Music at Bailey's Run and a 50th-anniversary celebration at Wisconsin Brewing Company, while tomorrow features the Crafty Fair at ART House 360 and music at Paddy Mac's.
In a notable incident on November 3rd, a domestic disturbance reported on Prairie Way Boulevard resulted in a man being arrested for intimidation of a victim and disorderly conduct.
Today's flavor at Culver's is Snickers Swirl and the store is currently open until 10:30 PM, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
